scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check service-worker.js && node --check src/exploreCore.mjs && node --check src/consultationCore.mjs && node --check src/hairAnalysis.mjs && node --check src/trendRegistry.mjs && node --check src/hairTrendData.mjs && node --check src/modelPreviewRegistry.mjs && node --check src/mobileProviderBridge.mjs && node --check consultation/app.mjs && node --check model-previews/app.mjs && node --check scripts/prepareMobileAssets.mjs && node --check scripts/doctorMobile.mjs && node --check scripts/generateHairDesignCatalog.mjs && node --check scripts/generateHairMasterCatalog.mjs && node --check scripts/syncHairTrends.mjs && node --check scripts/manageHairTrendSchedule.mjs && node --check scripts/checkHairTrendCadence.mjs && node --check scripts/checkHairTrendChanges.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const file of ['explore/index.html','consultation/index.html','model-previews/index.html'].filter(fs.existsSync)){const html=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');const scripts=[...html.matchAll(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)];for(const [,source] of scripts)new Function(source);console.log('HTML scripts parsed:',file,scripts.length)}"
